name: Key Operations
description: Encrypt, decrypt, extract the public key from, or change the passphrase of a private key.

examples.label: Extract the public key paired with a private key

hints.action: 「Extract the public key」 needs no passphrase: the passphrase protects the private material only.

faq.q: Can a forgotten passphrase be recovered?
faq.a: No. Passphrase encryption is one-way protection and the server keeps neither passphrases nor key copies.
Only for compatibility with existing data. It is a legacy algorithm and should not protect new key material.
